entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Stop by if you can.[n]I got something cool for ya.
entries.uk: Заскоч, якщо зможеш.[n]Маю для тебе дещо круте.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I'll be waiting for ya[n]here at the shop.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I know you got a lot going[n]on, but try to stop by.
entries.uk: Знаю, у тебе купа справ,[n]але постарайся заскочити.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Good. You got your head on[n]straight. OK, I'll be waiting.
entries.uk: Добре. Голова в тебе на місці.[n]Гаразд, чекаю.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, what's your plan? Will you accept[n]Iwai's invitation?
